summary: Python-based multi-agent architecture with enterprise patterns, VB6 legacy support, and containerized deployment conventions

rules.rule: Agent modules follow snake_case naming with descriptive suffixes (e.g., database_engineer.py, security_engineer.py)

provenance.evidence: Consistent snake_case naming across agent modules

rules.rule: VB6 forms use lowercase names with descriptive purposes (main.frm, login.frm, deposit.frm)

provenance.evidence: Form naming pattern in VB6 project

rules.rule: API endpoints use FastAPI decorators (@app.get, @app.post) for route definition
VB6 authentication uses password masking with PasswordChar property
VB6 uses basic error handling with minimal exception management
JSON schema validation used for agent contracts and data structures

lint_recommendations: Implement Python type hints across all agent modules
Add comprehensive error handling to VB6 form event handlers
Standardize API response formats across FastAPI endpoints
Add input validation for VB6 form controls
Implement logging standards across agent orchestration
scaffold_templates: BaseAgent class template for new agent implementations
FastAPI endpoint template with standard error handling
VB6 form template with consistent control naming
Docker container template for agent deployment
